# Hibiscus 0.8.34

This update refreshes code blocks and fixes a window-management issue when a
license-required action is selected.

- New Project now shows a license-required notice only in the window where
  the action started. Other windows stay minimized, and repeated clicks do not
  create duplicate notices. License access rules are unchanged.
- Code blocks have a single rounded background, line numbers, and a copy button
  that copies the code without its Markdown fences. Light and dark appearances
  use matching colors, without the previous extra gray strips.
- Tagged code blocks gain local syntax coloring for Swift, JavaScript,
  TypeScript, JSX, TSX, Python, JSON, shell, SQL, HTML, XML, and CSS. Untagged or
  unsupported languages remain plain text; no code is sent to a server.
- Pasting code preserves indentation and blank lines. Smart quotes no longer
  change quotation marks inside code, while normal prose keeps its own settings.
- Copy buttons refresh when opening another note or pasting a new code block.
  Fence markers appear only when their own line is being edited.

No note migration is required. This update does not claim to resolve the separate
large-library slowdown or intermittent resize-crash reports.
